site.name: Bahrain × Tunisia
site.purpose: A cultural exchange website by IEEE students celebrating Tunisia, Bahrain and what connects them.
site.defaultTitle: Bahrain × Tunisia | Two Nations. One Shared Spirit.
site.defaultDescription: Discover Tunisia and Bahrain, two nations with one shared spirit: destinations, traditions, food, history and the stories that connect them.

newsletter.title: Stay connected.
newsletter.text: Get stories, recipes and travel ideas from Tunisia and Bahrain in your inbox.

credits.title: Photo credits
credits.intro: The photos on this website come from Wikimedia Commons and other free-licence sources. They were resized and converted to WebP; no other changes were made. Thank you to every photographer.
credits.maps: Maps: Natural Earth (public domain) and © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Flags: country-flag-icons (MIT). Skyline, patterns and ornaments: original artwork for this project.
credits.empty: Photo credits will appear here once the photos are added.
